artworks.title: Jupiter and Mercury in the House of Philemon and Baucis
artworks.description: Rembrandt's candlelit cottage — the gods at the poor table where the wine bowl refilled itself and Phrygian pride was drowned.

artworks.title: Philemon and Baucis
artworks.description: The moment the old couple see leaves sprouting from each other's limbs — oak and linden guarding the temple ever after.
